thread:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — planning to onboard phi-7b-enc (7B, quantized) into the model catalog for private customers. Need a short deploy window and smoke-check owners. Targeting tomorrow 10:00 PST. This model will be pinned for privacy customers (PHI flow).

Jon Patel: I can own smoke tests (latency, perf, basic samplers). Do we have the pin config ready?

Maria Lopez: Pin config draft is in the registry PR — @Kevin can you confirm the rollout policy? We want immediate pin for enterprise tier, canary for hosted.

Kevin Wang: Yep — rollout policy: enterprise pinned -> dedicated -> hosted canary 10% for 6h -> 100% if no regression. Rollback signal: error rate >1% or average p95 latency +100ms vs baseline. I'll paste the pin CLI in a sec.

Shayna Ramos: From compliance: PHI checklist is green except KMS key binding for the catalog entry. @maria please ensure the model metadata has encryption_key: arn:aws:kms:... and data_retention: 90d.

Maria Lopez: Got it. Added the KMS ARN to the PR. Also added note: "private deployments only — do not expose in hosted catalog until QA sign-off".

Kevin Wang: Pin CLI (used by release bots):
```
redwood catalog pin --model phi-7b-enc --version v1.0.0 --targets enterprise,dedicated --policy canary:10%:6h --metadata '{"encryption_key":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:abcd","data_retention":"90d"}'
```
Use --dry-run first.

Jon Patel: For smoke tests I'll run: token-throughput, generate simple PHI redaction prompts, and a sanity embeddings job. Will post results here. Need a deploy approver for the canary?

Maria Lopez: @Shayna can you approve compliance once KMS binding verified? @sre-oncall please ack for scheduling 10:00 PST slot. We'll need a quick rollback plan (Kevin) and a logwatch dashboard link.

sre-oncall: Ack for 10:00 PST slot. I'll freeze other non-critical model flips during window and monitor infra. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/models/phi-7b-enc/smoke.

Shayna Ramos: I verified KMS binding in the PR and confirmed the private flag. Compliance approve ✅. No outstanding privacy blockers.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 1951320000 (2026-03-18 10:00:00 PST). Canary rollout configured 10% for 6h. Remember to run `--dry-run` then `--apply`.

Kevin Wang: Rollback playbook (short):
1) Immediately pin previous model: `redwood catalog pin --model phi-7b-enc --version v0.9.2 --targets all`
2) Disable hosted routing for phi-7b-enc in Smart Routing -> fallback to stable2
3) Revert registry PR and postmortem doc in #postmortems if triggered

Jon Patel: I'll be on standby at deploy time. Plan to run smoke checklist and post results in this thread within 15m of canary start.

Maria Lopez: Thanks team. Action items: Kevin finalize CLI args + rollback steps in PR, Jon smoke owner, Shayna compliance sign-off done, sre-oncall monitoring. Will merge PR after Kevin's final.

Jon Patel: Quick note — will also run a sample PHI redaction eval set (10 prompts). If any redaction fails >0, we hold.

Maria Lopez: Perfect. If nothing blocks, I'll merge at 09:30 PST and kick the deploy at 10:00.

Jon Patel: lgtm

Kevin Wang: lgtm

Shayna Ramos: lgtm :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: 👍
